node_features.npy.meaning: P2b parent graph node features copied unchanged

union_pairs.npy.meaning: context-only parent Delaunay pairs followed by NGC and SGC radius-only pairs

union_edge_features.npy.meaning: canonical u-to-v edge attributes copied unchanged

incident_edge_id.npy.meaning: each canonical pair occurs once at each endpoint

patch_arrays.parent_node_id: sorted immutable global parent node IDs
patch_arrays.union_edge_id: canonical edge IDs, originals then reverse copies
patch_arrays.edge_features: canonical attributes followed by reversed direction and inverse density contrast
patch_arrays.loss_mask: authoritative rows satisfying the architecture-specific strict dependency-hop mask

dependency_contract.dependency_hops: literal graph hops needed to reproduce the complete-graph core result
dependency_contract.current_attention_graphnet: dependency_hops = 2 * model_passes because sent edges are aggregated while attention is receiver-normalized

subdivision_contract: split authoritative core ownership recursively and regenerate complete dependency context for each subdivision; never cap or truncate nodes or edges

units.edge_length: observer-frame comoving Mpc, inherited unchanged from P2b
